items.name: instagram-follow
items.title: Instagram Follow
items.what_it_does: Instagram follow card pops in with avatar and a Follow button tap.
items.use_it_when: You say "follow me" or name your handle.

items.name: tiktok-follow
items.title: TikTok Follow
items.what_it_does: TikTok follow card with avatar and Follow button, vertical.
items.use_it_when: Same as above for a TikTok-first reel.

items.name: x-post
items.title: X Post Card
items.what_it_does: X post card with likes, reposts, and replies.
items.use_it_when: You quote or reference a tweet.

items.name: reddit-post
items.title: Reddit Post Card
items.what_it_does: Reddit post card with upvotes and comments.
items.use_it_when: You talk about a Reddit thread or story.

items.name: spotify-card
items.title: Spotify Now Playing
items.what_it_does: Spotify now-playing card with album art and progress bar, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You mention a song, podcast, or episode.

items.name: yt-comment-card
items.title: Comment Cards
items.what_it_does: Comments type in over footage with avatar, name, and likes.
items.use_it_when: You react to comments or show audience feedback.

items.name: thread-message-stack
items.title: Thread Message Stack
items.what_it_does: Editable stack of incoming and outgoing text messages.
items.use_it_when: You tell a story that happened over text.

items.name: social-proof-card
items.title: Social Proof Card
items.what_it_does: End card with wordmark, five stars, a proof line, and feature icons.
items.use_it_when: You close with proof that people use or like the thing.

items.name: testimonial-proof-card
items.title: Testimonial Proof Card
items.what_it_does: Quote card with a name and a line of praise.
items.use_it_when: You back a claim with a customer quote.

items.name: chatgpt-exchange
items.title: ChatGPT Exchange
items.what_it_does: ChatGPT-style prompt and answer on a phone screen, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You show what you asked an AI and what it said.

items.name: claude-exchange
items.title: Claude Exchange
items.what_it_does: Claude-style prompt and answer on a phone screen, vertical.
items.use_it_when: Same as above with a Claude look.

items.name: ai-chat-reveal
items.title: AI Chat Reveal
items.what_it_does: AI chat reply streams in, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You show an AI answer building line by line.

items.name: message-thread-reveal
items.title: Message Thread Reveal
items.what_it_does: Phone message thread revealed bubble by bubble, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You walk through a DM or text exchange.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat Thread
items.what_it_does: Chat conversation component, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You want a short chat as a reusable piece.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.what_it_does: Single chat bubble that pops in.
items.use_it_when: You need one message on screen.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.what_it_does: Three-dot typing bubble.
items.use_it_when: You build suspense before a reply lands.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.what_it_does: Text streams in like an AI reply.
items.use_it_when: You want an answer typed out word by word.

items.name: typed-prompt
items.title: Typed Prompt
items.what_it_does: Prompt typed into an input box.
items.use_it_when: You show the exact prompt you used.

items.name: notes-reveal
items.title: Notes Reveal
items.what_it_does: Notes app page typing out, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You share a list, script, or checklist.

items.name: notification-cascade
items.title: Notification Cascade
items.what_it_does: Phone notifications stack down the screen, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You joke about overload or show alerts piling up.

items.name: native-notification-pop
items.title: Native Notification Pop
items.what_it_does: One native-style notification springs in.
items.use_it_when: You say "I got a message" or a single alert.

items.name: slack-notification-ad
items.title: Slack Notification Ad
items.what_it_does: Slack notification on a phone, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You mention a Slack message or work ping.

items.name: share-sheet-carousel
items.title: Share-Sheet Carousel
items.what_it_does: Share sheet springs up and cycles previews, vertical.
items.use_it_when: You say "send this to someone".

items.name: sheet-spring-up
items.title: Sheet Spring-Up
items.what_it_does: Bottom sheet springs up over the frame.
items.use_it_when: You reveal a panel or menu from below.

items.name: badge-pop
items.title: Badge Pop
items.what_it_does: Small badge or count pops in.
items.use_it_when: You want a quick "new" or count marker.

items.name: success-check
items.title: Success Check
items.what_it_does: Animated check mark confirms success.
items.use_it_when: You land a win or finish a step.

items.name: spring-pop
items.title: Spring Pop
items.what_it_does: Any element pops with a spring overshoot.
items.use_it_when: You need a generic bouncy entrance.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.what_it_does: Confetti burst.
items.use_it_when: You celebrate. Use sparingly.

items.name: number-pop-in
items.title: Number Pop In
items.what_it_does: Number pops in with a bounce.
items.use_it_when: You hit a number that should land hard.

items.name: cta-lockup
items.title: CTA Lockup
items.what_it_does: Call-to-action lockup with text and button.
items.use_it_when: You end on "follow", "comment", or "link in bio".

items.name: hw-arrow
items.title: Hand-Drawn Arrow
items.what_it_does: Hand-drawn arrow draws on.
items.use_it_when: You point at something on screen.

items.name: hw-box-label
items.title: Hand-Drawn Box Label
items.what_it_does: Hand-drawn box with a label.
items.use_it_when: You label part of the frame.

items.name: hw-callout-circle
items.title: Scribble Callout Circle
items.what_it_does: Scribbled circle drawn around a spot.
items.use_it_when: You say "look at this".

items.name: hw-underline
items.title: Squiggle Marks
items.what_it_does: Squiggle underline or marks.
items.use_it_when: You stress a word or phrase.

items.name: hw-text-cloud
items.title: Speech Bubble
items.what_it_does: Hand-drawn speech bubble with typed text.
items.use_it_when: You add a thought bubble or aside.

items.name: marker-highlight
items.title: Marker Highlight
items.what_it_does: Marker highlight sweeps behind text.
items.use_it_when: You emphasize a phrase in a title.

items.name: yt-circle-pointer
items.title: Pointer Circle + Countdown
items.what_it_does: Circle pointer with a countdown.
items.use_it_when: You direct the eye to one spot for a few seconds.

items.name: yt-feather-highlight
items.title: Feathered Spotlight
items.what_it_does: Feathered spotlight dims the rest.
items.use_it_when: You focus attention on a region.

items.name: touch-indicator
items.title: Touch Indicator
items.what_it_does: Finger touch ripple on a phone screen.
items.use_it_when: You demo an app tap.

items.name: caption-highlight
items.title: Highlight
items.what_it_does: Captions with a colored sweep behind the active word, TikTok style.
items.use_it_when: Default social captions.

items.name: caption-pill-karaoke
items.title: Pill Karaoke
items.what_it_does: Captions with a pill that follows the spoken word.
items.use_it_when: You want the pill caption look.

items.name: caption-kinetic-slam
items.title: Kinetic Slam
items.what_it_does: One caption word at a time, slamming in from alternating directions.
items.use_it_when: High-energy lines.

items.name: caption-emoji-pop
items.title: Emoji Pop
items.what_it_does: Stroked captions with emoji that squeeze in.
items.use_it_when: Casual, fun reels.

items.name: caption-editorial-emphasis
items.title: Editorial Emphasis
items.what_it_does: Editorial captions with emphasis words in serif.
items.use_it_when: Calm, premium reels.

items.name: headline-slam
items.title: Headline Slam
items.what_it_does: Headline slams onto the frame.
items.use_it_when: A hook or big claim.

items.name: per-word-rise
items.title: Per Word Rise
items.what_it_does: Words rise in one by one.
items.use_it_when: A key sentence that should land word by word.

items.name: kinetic-type-swap
items.title: Kinetic Type Swap
items.what_it_does: One word swaps to another with motion.
items.use_it_when: You contrast two words.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.what_it_does: Typewriter text reveal.
items.use_it_when: A quiet line typed out.

items.name: hw-write-title
items.title: Handwritten Write-On Title
items.what_it_does: Handwritten title writes on.
items.use_it_when: A personal, human title.

items.name: lt-clean-bar
items.title: Lower Third — Clean Bar
items.what_it_does: White bar lower third with name and role.
items.use_it_when: You introduce a guest or yourself.

items.name: lt-soft-pill
items.title: Lower Third — Soft Pill
items.what_it_does: Rounded pill lower third with a status dot.
items.use_it_when: A soft, friendly name tag.

items.name: lt-kicker-name
items.title: Lower Third — Kicker Name
items.what_it_does: Lower third with kicker line above the name.
items.use_it_when: You add a role label above a name.

items.name: yt-lower-third
items.title: YouTube Lower Third
items.what_it_does: YouTube subscribe lower third.
items.use_it_when: A subscribe or channel prompt.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.what_it_does: Number counts up to a value.
items.use_it_when: You cite a stat.

items.name: number-wheel
items.title: Number Wheel
items.what_it_does: Odometer-style number wheel.
items.use_it_when: A number that rolls to a final value.

items.name: mk-progress-stat
items.title: Count-Up Stat Card
items.what_it_does: Big stat with a thin progress track.
items.use_it_when: A stat out of a total.

items.name: animated-bar-chart
items.title: Animated Bar Chart
items.what_it_does: Compact bar chart with callouts.
items.use_it_when: You compare a few numbers.

items.name: mk-line-graph
items.title: Minimal Line Graph
items.what_it_does: Minimal line graph.
items.use_it_when: A trend going up or down.

items.name: conic-progress-ring
items.title: Conic Progress Ring
items.what_it_does: Progress ring fills to a percent.
items.use_it_when: A percentage result.

items.name: star-rating-fill
items.title: Star Rating Fill
items.what_it_does: Star rating fills to a value.
items.use_it_when: You cite a rating.

items.name: screen-flow-carousel
items.title: Screen Flow Carousel
items.what_it_does: Screens slide through a rail.
items.use_it_when: You walk through app screens.

items.name: swipe-rail
items.title: Swipe Rail
items.what_it_does: Swipeable card rail with gesture.
items.use_it_when: You show options to swipe through.

items.name: spring-stack-shuffle
items.title: Spring Stack Shuffle
items.what_it_does: Stack of cards shuffles with spring physics.
items.use_it_when: You flip through several ideas or tips.

items.name: three-orbiting-cards
items.title: Three Orbiting Cards
items.what_it_does: Three cards orbit in 3D (Three.js).
items.use_it_when: A small set of featured items.

items.name: carousel-path-1
items.title: Path Carousel 1
items.what_it_does: Image cards ride a curved path.
items.use_it_when: You show a set of photos or posts.

items.name: device-frame-stage
items.title: Device Frame Stage
items.what_it_does: Phone or tablet frame that holds a screen.
items.use_it_when: You show a screen recording in a device.

items.name: multi-device-splay
items.title: Multi Device Splay
items.what_it_does: Several devices fan out.
items.use_it_when: You show an app on phone, tablet, and desktop.

items.name: before-after-wipe
items.title: Before After Wipe
items.what_it_does: Before and after wipe.
items.use_it_when: You show a change.

items.name: yt-vertical-fill
items.title: Vertical Media Filler
items.what_it_does: Vertical media filler placeholder.
items.use_it_when: You need a 9:16 slot for a clip or image.

items.name: grain-overlay
items.title: Grain Overlay
items.what_it_does: Film grain over the frame.
items.use_it_when: You want a subtle film feel.

items.name: camera-shake
items.title: Camera Shake
items.what_it_does: Handheld camera shake.
items.use_it_when: You add energy to an impact beat.

items.name: freeze-frame-dressing
items.title: Freeze-Frame Dressing
items.what_it_does: Paper, tape, and flash dressing around a freeze frame.
items.use_it_when: You freeze on a moment as a scrapbook beat.

items.name: whip-pan-cut
items.title: Whip Pan Cut
items.what_it_does: Whip pan with motion blur between shots.
items.use_it_when: A fast cut between scenes.

items.name: iris-reveal
items.title: Iris Reveal
items.what_it_does: Circle iris opens to the next shot.
items.use_it_when: A soft reveal.

items.name: fade-through
items.title: Fade Through
items.what_it_does: Fade through a color.
items.use_it_when: A gentle scene change.

items.name: hw-scribble-transition
items.title: Scribble Transition
items.what_it_does: Scribble wipe between shots.
items.use_it_when: A hand-made look.

items.name: torn-paper-rip
items.title: Torn Paper Rip
items.what_it_does: Paper rips to reveal the next shot.
items.use_it_when: A scrapbook or collage look.

items.name: flash-through-white
items.title: Flash Through White
items.what_it_does: Flash to white between shots.
items.use_it_when: A punchy cut.

items.name: editorial-flash-overlay
items.title: Editorial Flash Overlay
items.what_it_does: Editorial flash overlay on a cut.
items.use_it_when: A beat accent on a cut.

items.name: logo-outro
items.title: Logo Outro
items.what_it_does: Logo reveal with tagline and URL pill.
items.use_it_when: You end with your brand.
